kind: executable V8 live reward/checkpoint export feature and software verification
user_instruction: 너도 코드 작업해; source/H100 instructions after git push
hypothesis: Active/interrupted runs can export surviving per-update training rewards before finalization, preserve25-update checkpoint coverage, and keep skipped held-out points unmeasured without calling an evaluator.

implementation.operations: JSON/JSONL input; optional streaming checkpoint SHA; atomic immutable export generations + latest.json; no pickle/torch import in exporter

data_model_transformation.model: code-repository ToyBackend, not a language model experiment
controls: conflicting duplicate and abandoned attempt exclusion
known final vs missing intermediate evaluations

metric_definitions.training: logged per-update training-batch sample_reward; response denominator only when recorded in training_stats, never guessed
metric_definitions.heldout: separate dev/final question-level integer counts; aggregate checked, snapshot index/path/hash linkage reported
metric_definitions.checkpoint: default file existence/path only; --verify-checkpoints streams SHA256; payload/optimizer/RNG contents are not loaded or certified
metric_definitions.coverage: 25-update retained points through recorded evidence boundary; missing training/checkpoints fail --strict; absent held-out evaluations are explicitly unmeasured and allowed

integration.scope: CPU ToyBackend software integration; NOT RLVR scientific measurements

scientific_results.Gemma_H100_stall_status: not addressed or verified by these CPU tests

test_environment_note: Root tests/conftest.py imports selection_gate_gpu which is unavailable in this checkout. Initial default pytest attempts exited4 at collection. New standalone tests use --noconftest because they do not use that historical trainer fixture; no existing fixture/trainer was changed. Intermediate30/37/38-pass suites and final39-pass suite are retained.

test_environment_failures.error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'selection_gate_gpu' while loading tests/conftest.py

raw_evidence_and_checkpoints.runtime_software_source: verification/runtime-source-manifest.json (peer source hashes, captured before its final commit)
raw_evidence_and_checkpoints.preservation: Every prior test run uses its own directory; no real/in-flight experiment or raw source artifact was changed.

limitations: Run manifests discovered under the given root define the inventory; future or uncreated matrix tasks are not declared complete.
Exporter reads per-file snapshots; it flags manifest changes but does not certify an atomic snapshot of a live run across all files.
Presence/hash of a checkpoint does not independently verify complete optimizer/RNG recovery; actual H100 progress and measurements remain unverified.
